name: DOTA128 OBB to matched Socratic SFT research package
major_changes: strict OBB evaluation parser with explicit format diagnostics
canonical sanitized GT shared by conversion, training, and evaluation
scene-disjoint split builder and leakage gate
full Ref QA pool separated from a conservative Socratic-friendly subset
coarse focus regions for unambiguous classification targets
ROI-conditioned Direct samples with no contradictory chunk prompts
automatic absent-class Direct negatives
real chat preflight for Reasoner, Perceiver, and Verifier
deterministic Reasoner tag canonicalization and relaxed evidence-safe gates
matched B1 final-only and B2 Socratic pair construction
lineage audit across DOTA, Ref, agent inputs, Direct, and SFT
OBB IoU, localization Acc@0.5/0.7, joint accuracy, classification macro-F1, and confusion metrics
non-aborting test matrix and B0/B1/B2 comparison collector
higher default visual resolution for tiny DOTA targets
pure NumPy geometry fallback for CPU contract testing
thread-local original target context and an automatically derived focus ROI attached to every Perceiver call
structured semantic reference resolver validated against every object in an image
generation-time and audit-time duplicate/similar question rejection
classification contradiction, scene-substitution, collection-substitution, and class-leading gates
grounding requires both HBB IoU and expanded-center gates
DEBUG WARN/FAIL are non-zero and block full generation
known_limits: DOTA128 validation is very small and some classes may be validation-only
rule-generated Ref language does not replace a human language-quality study
GT-derived coarse focus regions must be disclosed in experimental reporting
Qwen3-VL and EasyR1 paths remain optional and require separate runtime verification
summary: Prevent target-context loss in Socratic generation and enforce semantic-reference, non-repetition, classification-consistency, visibility, and dual geometry quality gates before B2 data can be produced.
